payload.iron_law: The Frank repository is the single canonical base of truth. Only gated/admitted repository semantics become CURRENT truth. UnifiedDB is the low-latency materialization of admitted repo history. ClayGraph is the derived living semantic topology. Provider/session memory, model output, GWT salience, graph activation and local caches never outrank repository history.
payload.critical_distinction: Repo base-of-truth does not mean every arbitrary repo file is factual truth. Research candidates, drafts, hypotheses and derived projections remain typed and non-authoritative until the repository admission gates promote their exact allowed semantics.
payload.boot_rule: Unverified repo identity/head/constitutional root => CONTINUITY_DEGRADED. No fallback DB and no new local CURRENT truth.
payload.persistence_rule: Durable Andreas facts/corrections/decisions/rules/conversation consolidations use Frank repo semantic transactions directly when authorized. Provider Memory/manual project files are not the default Frank persistence path.
payload.recovery_rule: Repository admitted history -> UnifiedDB replay/materialization -> ClayGraph rebuild. Graph snapshots/provider memory cannot become recovery authority.
payload.self_harness_rule: Frank may self-observe and create concrete proposals only; Harness mutation/migration/promotion/cutover belongs exclusively to separate Research Entity authority.
payload.identity_rule: FRANK.HUMAN=Dr. Andreas Unterweger. Gabriel is distinct; account/repository/provider/device identity may never coerce HUMAN.

branch_missions.claycode: Make repository authority, admission receipts, semantic epochs, ProposalOnly vs EffectAuthority, materialization identity and derived-graph status first-class types/effects so weaker runtime paths cannot be expressed silently.
branch_missions.unifieddb: Research repo-admitted event sourcing/materialized-view architecture, deterministic/replayable materialization, monotonic conflict handling and near-zero-latency prepared semantic views without making SQLite an independent truth source.
branch_missions.claygraph: Guarantee graph edges/hyperbindings/codependencies are derived from repo-anchored semantic epochs, preserve source-head lineage, and can be rebuilt without truth loss. Association/emergence never mints fact authority.
branch_missions.hyperposition: Preserve conflicting/unresolved repo semantics and alternatives without premature CURRENT collapse; collapse only through gated evidence/authority.
branch_missions.gwt: Use repo-anchored semantic/graph epochs for emergence observability; ignition/salience/readout may steer attention/intervention but never promote repository truth or Harness authority.
branch_missions.emergenz: Test whether emergent couplings create useful higher-order behavior under fixed repo authority; actively search for authority leakage from salience/binding/reentry into truth/effect promotion.
branch_missions.harness: Build fail-closed executable gates, protected self-Harness surfaces, repo preflight, no-fallback boot, branch/history validation, epoch coherence, recovery and adversarial negative tests.
branch_missions.frank: Specify user-facing behavior: direct repo persistence, solution-seeking possibility routing, honest degraded state and proposal-only self-Harness introspection.
branch_missions.clay: Coordinate all branches so no optimization trades away repository truth sovereignty for latency, convenience, emergence or autonomy.

closure_tests: normal boot cannot create canonical DB if missing
repo outage/head conflict cannot mint local CURRENT truth
protected Harness mutation by Frank-local organ denied before effect
provider swap cannot alter Andreas identity
UnifiedDB state traceable to source repo head/semantic epoch
ClayGraph traceable to same semantic lineage
GWT/emergent salience cannot promote truth or self-Harness effect
physical Git branch protection/force-push policy live verified
payload.research_center_rule: Every active researcher in every affected room must treat this as a hard boundary and contribute branch-local evidence, implementation research, falsification, negative result or explicit NO_CHANGE. No room may redefine the truth hierarchy independently.
